contextDiscovery.taxonomy: CTX v2: 4h EMA50/EMA200 spread + ATR14/close + training-only q99 single-bar shock override.

definitions.trend: EMA50/EMA200 spread; SIDEWAYS when absolute spread <= training q30 flat threshold, otherwise UP/DOWN by sign.
definitions.volatility: Wilder ATR14/close; LOW <= training q33, NORMAL <= training q67, HIGH above q67.
definitions.shock: SHOCK override when absolute completed 4h return > training q99.
definitions.unknown: UNKNOWN/TRANSITION/INSUFFICIENT_DATA when inputs stale, missing, forming-only or below lookback.

current.classificationConfidence: Qualitative feature separation only; not calibrated and not a win probability.
current.transitionRule: No context flip across the last two completed 4h bars.
current.emaWindow: 1,499 completed 4h bars; full-history thresholds retained; recursive EMA seed still uses a 1,500-bar tail rather than all 13,454 rows.

caveats: The current EMA50/EMA200 state uses a 1,500-bar tail, not full-history recursive state; it matches the previous v88 tail window but remains approximate near boundaries.
Feature-separation confidence is heuristic, not trade-win probability.
Historical CTX v2 excludes derivatives/liquidity features.
